places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Elmira rides the whiskey boat upriver, sensing Big Zwey watching her, until the cargo is unloaded into wagons.
places.location_hint: river route the whiskey boat followed west toward Bent's Fort

places.name: Bent's Fort
places.note: A shabby, busy trading post reeking of buffalo hides; Elmira lodges in a flea-ridden closet and agrees to let Big Zwey take her to Ogallala.
places.location_hint: trading post on the plains reached by wagon from the whiskey boat's landing

places.name: Plains north of Bent's Fort
places.note: Elmira drives a patched hide wagon while the men hunt buffalo; she nearly overturns at a steep creek and shelters under the wagon in a storm.
places.location_hint: open prairie a few days' wagon travel out from Bent's Fort, heading toward Ogallala on the Platte

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Fowler names it as a northern town on the Platte; Big Zwey offers to take Elmira there.

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Fowler says Ogallala lies on it.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Elmira doubts the rickety hide wagon can reach it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Fowler says there are towns there but it is far away.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Elmira felt she had to escape it at once, fearing July would return.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: In the cow towns, she reflects, one could always take a stage from Dodge to elsewhere.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: Mentioned as the alternative cow town reachable by stage from Dodge.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Hide haulers could take her there, but Elmira refuses, having been there before.

groups.label: Elmira with Big Zwey and Luke
groups.hint: a few days out from Bent's Fort by hide wagon, bound for Ogallala

groups.label: Fowler
groups.hint: planning to go back downriver the following week
